title: Flock/Axon HECVAT responses (University of Northern Iowa)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Iowa Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any Higher Education Community Vendor Assessment Toolkit (HECVAT) questionnaire, in any version (Lite, Full, On-Premise, or numbered 2.x, 3.x, or 4.x), completed by or on behalf of Flock Group Inc. d/b/a Flock Safety and held by this institution, whether received from the vendor directly or downloaded from the EDUCAUSE Community Broker Index or another repository. This includes any HECVAT covering, by any name, Flock's Falcon license plate reader cameras, Flock Safety Platform, FlockOS, Flock911, Flock Nova, Raven audio/gunshot detection, Condor video cameras, or Flock drone / drone-as-first-responder services (including Aerodome).
2. Any HECVAT questionnaire, in any version, completed by or on behalf of Axon Enterprise, Inc. and held by this institution, on the same terms. This includes any HECVAT covering, by any name, Axon Outpost, Fusus (Axon Fusus / Fusus ONE / Real-Time Crime Center), Axon Evidence (Evidence.com), Axon Body cameras, Axon Fleet in-car systems including Fleet ALPR, Axon Respond, Axon Records, Axon Air, Axon Standards, or Axon Investigate.

HECVATs are generally completed per product or solution, so a vendor may have submitted more than one; I request all of them. If no HECVAT exists for a vendor or product, please say so rather than treating the item as a nil response for the vendor as a whole.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

HCvP

communications.subject: South Carolina Public Records Law Request: FOIA Request: Flock Audits
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the South Carolina Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Organization Audit in Flock.
The data logged from the period of July 1, 2026 to July 30, 2026. Per Flock's documentation, the Organization Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches done within the agency. The data should include all selectable columns.

2. Network Audit in Flock.
The data logged from the period of July 1, 2026 to July 30, 2026. Per Flock's documentation, the Network Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches of the organization’s Flock network by any agency in the Flock System. The data should include all selectable columns.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request be filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days for records less than 24-months-old, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

m

title: Jefferson County Settlement Heisel v. Jefferson County

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Iowa Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records concerning Heisel v. Jefferson County, Iowa, et al., No. 4:25-cv-00505 (S.D. Iowa):

1. The written settlement agreement resolving the above action, which was dismissed with prejudice by stipulation filed September 2, 2026.
2. If the settlement agreement does not itself state the identity of the parties, the nature of the dispute, and the terms of the settlement including any payments made by or on behalf of the County, the summary of the settlement required by Iowa Code § 22.13.

Sincerely,

HCvP

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: SDOT Digital Kiosks
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Regarding digital kiosks installed by the City, please provide:
1. All aggregated metrics of user interactions with Kiosks
2. All Kiosk-related manuals and training materials
3. All invoices regarding revenue received from Kiosk advertising so far
4. All invoices regarding "public safety benefits and capital improvements" funded by Kiosk revenue

Please be aware that section 14 of the City's MOU with DSA (CB 120992) requires DSA to collect records related to the Kiosks and make them available as public records. Please be aware that I am submitting this request to the MO because SDOT stated that "it was the MO that was the party that led that MOU."

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Rose Terse
